title: Luke 17:11-19
subtitle: Thanksgiving Day (USA) · Sir 50:22-24; 1 Cor 1:3-9; Lk 17:11-19
text: Ten lepers were healed, but only one, a Samaritan, came back praising God and fell at Jesus' feet to thank him. Gratitude is the return trip. Before the Thanksgiving meal, go back and say thank you.
imageAlt: Watercolor of Jesus in a white robe standing on a rocky hillside with his arm raised, as ten bandaged lepers kneel and lift their hands toward him, with a hillside village and olive trees behind
credit: James Tissot, The Healing of Ten Lepers (Guérison de dix lépreux), 1886-1894, Brooklyn Museum. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons
